DHC.title: Daggerheart Cockpit
DHC.hint: Private GM notes. Drafts are backed up only in this browser; use Save to persist them in the journal.
DHC.conflict: The journal changed since your draft began. Copy your input, then discard the draft with Refresh. Stale edits will not be saved.
DHC.challengesHint: Optional: What makes intervention difficult, and what is at stake?
DHC.approachesHint: Optional: Approaches and possible rolls, not a required sequence. Roll only when the action is uncertain and something is at stake.
DHC.interventionHint: Optional: Plausible reactions to different actions, not predetermined outcomes. A success with Fear remains a success.
DHC.drop: Drag Actors, Journals, Scenes or RollTables here from the sidebar.
DHC.spotlightHint: Manually mark who had a meaningful moment. Not an action counter.
DHC.removeEventWarning: Permanently delete this event? Previously converted notes, edited summary previews and published journals remain unchanged.
DHC.empty: Create your first session on the left.
DHC.primaryGM: Only the active primary GM can write. Other GMs can read.
DHC.gmOnly: The cockpit is for GMs only.
DHC.missingPage: The managed journal page is missing. No data was changed.
DHC.discard: Discard the local draft and load the saved journal?
DHC.draftSaved: Not saved in journal · draft backed up locally
DHC.draftUnavailable: Local draft backup unavailable · please save to the journal
DHC.draftError: The local draft could not be read or saved.
DHC.closeWithoutDraft: The draft is not backed up locally. Close anyway? Input may be lost.
DHC.conversionWarning: Append the edited text to the selected destination? The original event will remain unchanged.
DHC.createdFromEvent: New thread created. Use Attach to connect it to the session.
DHC.unifiedNotesHint: Use this editor for all contributions. Choose General session notes for experiences, questions or next goals; choose the matching category for people, places and clues.
DHC.legacyPlayerDraft: An unsaved free-text draft from the previous editor is available.
DHC.loadLegacyPlayerDraft: Load old draft into this editor
DHC.bookAcrossSessions: Entries from all enabled sessions, grouped by category and title. They do not create Actors or Scenes or confirm campaign facts.
DHC.bookRequired: Please enter a title and note.
DHC.deleteBookWarning: Permanently delete this campaign book entry? Published summaries remain unchanged.
DHC.enablePlayerNotes: Enable player notes for this session
DHC.enablePlayerNotesWarning: Create separate notes journals readable by everyone for each player? The session name becomes visible, but private GM notes are not copied. Enabling again adds notebooks for new players.
DHC.playerNotesWarning: All players and GMs can read saved contributions. Do not enter secrets. Contributions are perspectives and theories, not automatically confirmed facts.
DHC.myPlayerNotes: My contribution: events, clues, questions and next goals
DHC.noOwnNotebook: You do not have a notes journal yet. Ask the GM to enable player notes for the session.
DHC.ownNotesOnly: You can only edit your own contribution.
DHC.summaryHint: Include only explicitly selected events and fields. Review the preview for secrets before publishing.
DHC.publishWarning: Create a separate journal readable by all players? Only the preview text is published; private GM journals remain unchanged.
DHC.summaryRequired: Please enter a title and summary.
DHC.replaceSummary: Replace the edited preview with the newly selected content?
DHC.replaceConversion: Replace the edited conversion text with another event?
DHC.selectSummary: Select at least one item for the summary.
DHC.published: Player summary published as a separate journal.
